programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan is surrounded by a group of thugs who have their rifles pointed at him. From a distance, The British officer and Kuwar Singh witness this scene and the latter tells that Indravadhan's rule over Ameerkot is gradually coming to an end. On the other hand, Raj Mata is searching for something among the set of books and at the same juncture, Gayatri arrives. Gayatri tells Raj Mata that is feeling uneasy and fears that Indravadhan seems to be in trouble. Will Indravadhan be able to set himself free from the thugs? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Tha Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan asks his men to put down their weapons as he realizes that Gayatri's life is in danger. But one of Indravadhan's men shoots him and the goons flee with Gayatri. However, a stranger appears out of nowhere and hears Gayatri in distress. He apprehends the goons, rescues Gayatri and is astonished when Gayatri goes and embraces Indravadhan, who then reaches the place. Later, Rajmata continues to search for Yashodha and Chandravadhan is hopeful that Rajmata remains unaware of the fact that Yashodha is now dead. Just then, Gayatri and Indravadhan enter the scene. How will Rajmata react when she notices their condition? Tune in to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: The man who had saved Gayatri tells to one of his men that his fight for Ameerkot has begun and he is going to fight Indravadhan; defeat him and capture his wife. The following day, the same man visits Ameerkot and stops a ritual that Indravadhan was performing. This act infuriates every member of Ameerkot and Indravadhan asks the man to introduce himself. The man claims himself to be Avdesh Singh Chauhan, the heir of a landlord, who once owned Ameerkot's land. He demands Indravadhan to return Ameerkot back to him. What will Indravadhan's response be to Avdesh Singh Chauhan? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri acknowledges the fact how Indravadhan's grandfather won the land on which Ameerkot stands today. Gayatri decides to stop Indravadhan from fighting the battle for Ameerkot. On the other hand, Kokila and Kuwar Singh think whether this war would bring them personal victory over Indravadhan or a loss for Ameerkot. Later, Gayatri meets Indravadhan to convince and stop him from battling Avdesh Singh Chauhan. Will Indravadhan agree to his wife's request? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan is all set to fight Avdesh Singh Chauhan. Gayatri, meanwhile, prays for her husband's safety. Avdesh shows up and confronts Indravadhan. He insults Indravadhan in front of the people gathered at Raj Mahal. Avdesh ties his signature anklet to one of his legs and picks up a spear. Seeing Avdesh armed with a spear, Indravadhan too exchanges his sword with a spear. Will Indravadhan be able to defeat Avdesh Singh Chauhan? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan tends to his wound which got from his battle with Avdesh Singh Chauhan. Gayatri helps him and asks whether is he hurt bad. Indravadhan tells Gayatri that he was hurt when his wife did not trust his capability. Avdesh too gets medicine applied on his wounds and he thinks about Gayatri all this while. Indravadhan meets Avdesh and they discuss about their friendship. Gayatri discusses with Raj Mata about Indravadhan's anger on her. What advice would Raj Mata give Gayatri? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Poseidon Rex
programme.desc: While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Day Of Reckoning
programme.desc: John awakens from a coma to discover his wife and daughter were murdered in a brutal home invasion. Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

programme.title: Redline
programme.desc: Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs. The film follows a gorgeous young automobile fanaticize driver who becomes part of illegal drag racing competitions organized by exotic car fanatics.

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: Wrecker
programme.desc: Two beautiful young women taking a trip through the countryside, are terrorized by an unknown driver trying to run them down in a heavy duty tow truck.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Regeneration
programme.desc: Terrorists kidnap the Russian Prime Minister's two kids, take Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant and threaten to blow up a reactor. Four Universal Soldiers go in but are no match to a Next Generation UniSol. The world's only hope is to reactivate decommissioned Universal Soldier Luc Deveraux.

programme.title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
programme.desc: Suffering from amnesia, a young man trying to discover his true identity is kidnapped by an underground crime organization and turned into a ruthless assassin

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: With an ensemble cast, this gripping, espionage thriller brings to life the true story of Moe Berg a World War II spy. His mission: go behind enemy lines in Europe to assassinate the Nazi's chief nuclear scientist before the Germans develop an atomic bomb. Berg must rely on his steel-trap intellect in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse - with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

programme.title: Soul For Sole
programme.desc: The real essence of life is found in serving others. A regular postman, with little else in his world but his job, faithfully delivers letters throughout his challenging life. One day, an unexpected encounter offers him a new purpose to live

programme.title: The Moment
programme.desc: One evening, Dhirendra (40 yrs.) is eager to head home, yet the taxi driver is awaiting additional passengers. Eventually, a lone passenger arrives, prompting the taxi to proceed. As the driver requests fares and mentions a lack of change, a comedic spectacle ensues between the passengers and the driver. Ultimately, the narrative takes a humorous twist, concluding with a happy ending.

programme.title: U Equals To Me
programme.desc: Nikita and Neeraj know each other well, but their relationship feels awkward. Nikita finds Neeraj's touches repulsive. Aniket has proposed, but she can't let go of Neeraj. Why does she seem stuck between a rock and a hard place? What’s the matter with Neeraj? Is it some deficiency, disability or a disease? It would need a silver bullet to get them together. What if the silver bullet already exists, unknown to them?

programme.title: Tall Girlfriend Dates Short Guy
programme.desc: In this charming comedy, a couple navigates the ups and downs of their relationship, with him being shorter and her towering over him. From playful teasing by the maid to awkward encounters, his height becomes a source of humor and occasional frustration. However, amidst the laughs and challenges, her unwavering love reassures him that their bond transcends any physical differences. Join them on a delightful journey of love and laughter, where acceptance triumphs over insecurities.

programme.title: The Red Suitcase
programme.desc: A lone taxi driver’s quiet routine is shattered when she picks up a seemingly innocent passenger carrying a RED suitcase. What begins as a simple ride turns into a twisted journey, as the driver uncovers chilling clues hidden inside the suitcase that lead her into the dark mystery. She must navigate the gritty streets and her growing paranoia to survive a night that will change everything.

programme.title: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: A mother’s unwavering love gives her child the strength to face fears, embrace courage, and discover the true meaning of freedom. This inspiring tale celebrates the power of love, resilience, and the journey toward self-discovery.

programme.title: Wazir
programme.desc: A crime thriller that showcases the tale of an impeccably executed murder, where the culprits cleverly evade justice through meticulous planning and a lack of incriminating evidence.

programme.title: Taashe
programme.desc: Shiv Kothari, a village boy of 8 years is not at all interested to learn taashe (a musical instrument ), his family, and his ancestral business. What changes him so suddenly that he becomes keen to learn taashe. Who changes him so much that he decides to play taashe professionally. Watch a unique love and marriage story of two kids

programme.title: Vinyamswaha
programme.desc: You will take me for a ride in the sky, Vinay, when you become a pilot." These words have haunted Vinay throughout his life like a fearful shadow. Born into a Brahmin family, Vinay fell in love with a Valmiki girl. However, representatives of the caste-driven society, cloaked in prejudice, turned his love into a vile and grotesque joke. Today, Vinay is serving a life sentence for the rape and murder of his own girlfriend.

programme.title: Ravan Chhaya
programme.desc: Ravan-Chhaya" is a poignant short film that delves into the struggle to preserve Indian culture and traditions amidst the relentless tide of Western influence and modernization. Set in the culturally rich state of Odisha, the story revolves around the fading art form of Ravan-Chhaya, a traditional shadow puppetry style that once thrived in the region but is now on the brink of extinction.

programme.title: Thanks Mom
programme.desc: Thanks Mom is a human & a universal story of every mother & son that will melt your hearts away. The film's strength is its emotional value and connectivity to the viewers. It is the most honest & truest form of interpretation of a mother's role. It highlights a mom-son connection that is frayed and rough around the edges, filled with awkward silences and unsaid feelings that both find difficult to navigate but come around for each other when the time comes.

programme.title: Zindagi Ek Kashmakash
programme.desc: Zindagi Ek Kashmakash is a heart-wrenching story of a single mother, Rani, who has been abandoned by his boyfriend. Rani makes a living as a prostitute to support her only son, Ajay. Despite the harsh reality of her life, Rani is determined to provide a better future for Ajay. As Ajay grows older, he begins to worry that something is not quite right with his mother's job.

programme.title: Uljhan
programme.desc: After an unresolved breakup, Kartik and Ishita reunite for one last conversation. As memories resurface, so do the feelings. But closure doesn’t always mean getting back together. Uljhan is a tender tale of emotional maturity, heartbreak, and growth.

programme.title: Parinay
programme.desc: The narrative explores our thought processes, whose opinions we value, and how we handle a common issue faced by many couples: when a minor disagreement escalates into a pointless argument.

programme.title: The Apple
programme.desc: Story of two kids and how their life coincides whilst exchanging an Apple. The story reflects the societal dichotomy under the same sky in a small town near Delhi. The film is Accredited in the British Council Global Film directory and quoted by BBC as an "absolutely brilliant thought-provoking film.

programme.title: The Last Act
programme.desc: "THE LAST ACT" follows Chitra, a method actor known for her ability to fully immerse herself into any role. However, as she prepares for her latest performance, she begins to lose touch with reality, seamlessly transitioning between characters and struggling to discern where her performances end and her true self begins.

programme.title: Uyire
programme.desc: 'Uyire' explores the feeling of Love & how differently it is perceived from its actual implied meaning, whilst being a social commentary on the class system that is habitually rooted in Urban cities. Indrajit & Zoya, two contrasting individuals try to find a space where both of them feel respected. The film explores how an individual's upbringing, background, class, responsibilities, shapes their mindset, which ultimately leave Indrajit & Zoya at a stage of uncertainty.

programme.title: The Perception
programme.desc: This story follows the journey of a professional photographer and a poor cycle rickshaw driver in Mumbai at the end of spring. Through various incidents on the road, their perceptions of each other change, highlighting the contrast between their social statuses. Ultimately, their experiences weave together to create a beautiful narrative of understanding and connection.

programme.title: Prowl
programme.desc: A young girl pays a visit to a mysterious stranger after connecting with him through a dating site. What follows is either a cautionary tale or a parable, based on how you view it.

programme.title: Woh Khaas
programme.desc: A business tycoon bored with his monotonous work-life escapes from his corporate setup for a day and ends up meeting a girl, who like a dream changes him upside down in a real ‘Filmy Manner’. Woh Khaas is a jazzy tribute to Bollywood romances that tries to combine the reality of love and the flamboyance of Indian cinema in an entertaining and enriching way.

programme.title: Trp
programme.desc: A victims father tries to get justice for his daughter despite the failed situation system in place.

programme.title: Uljhe Ho Kyun
programme.desc: Fitness influencer Abhay’s quirky habit of messaging his first likes leads him to Srishti, a corporate workaholic. As sparks fly, their contrasting worlds collide in a playful yet unpredictable romance. Will their chemistry sizzle or turn to ashes? A fun, fiery take on modern love.

programme.title: Writer
programme.desc: A quiet evening between a writer and his wife unravels into a surreal exploration of love, memory, and hidden truths. As reality shifts, so do the stories they’ve been telling themselves—and each other.

programme.title: The Decision
programme.desc: The Struggle of a Female Actress in the Film Industry: A young woman faces difficulties when working with a demanding director who creates a stressful environment. She expresses her concerns to the producer, but he reacts angrily and uses harsh language toward her. Will the actress decide to find a way to work together or stand up for herself?

programme.title: Humraz
programme.desc: This is the story of a couple who tried to raise their voice against the undesirable practice of one community. Hamraz is a witness to the hero playing Ravanahatha and the incidents that happened to him... Sometimes the image that looks white is also black... Humraz is a story full of mysteries... The curtain will soon fall on all the secrets and the real story will come out in front of everyone..

programme.title: Swad Anusar
programme.desc: A rich businessman loses his memory after a blow to the head but returns home alive after being thought dead. His family doesn't believe him and he realizes they may have conspired to kill him. He dies after eating poisoned food his wife prepared. His family admits their plot, but he will return with greater vengeance.

programme.title: The Footage
programme.desc: A spy dies in an elevator leaving a message on the CCTV footage. A lip-reader is called to find out what he said

programme.title: Two Strangers
programme.desc: This narrative revolves around a man with a scientific background, unwaveringly devoted to science and sceptical of miracles. He’s dealing with a mysterious health condition, leaving every doctor surprised. It’s like a puzzle and everyone around him is clueless about it. In a surprising twist, destiny intervenes to miraculously resolve his health issue, and he remains oblivious to this extraordinary turn of events, adding a layer of intrigue to the unfolding narrative.

programme.title: The Unsent Letter
programme.desc: Nidhi is haunted by her past; she's caged in it when suddenly she gets interrupted by a waiter asking for her order. After she pulls herself together, she realizes that the waiter had called her by her name. Nidhi finds out that the waiter is a man from her past. She is now left with a choice to face her nightmare and finally let go of everything that has haunted her till now or to continue living her life in a cage.

programme.title: The Please Book
programme.desc: Dora is a small girl from a rich family who lives with her father, a busy businessman. Due to his busy schedule, he is unable to spend quality time with her. Dora is very lonely and she does not have any friends. Her loneliness ends when one day she finds an old diary with “The Please Book” written on its cover. Soon she discovers it’s not an ordinary diary but a magical book. She believes that whatever you write in The Please Book, comes true.

programme.title: Yaantrik
programme.desc: Siddharth is a novelist. He is known for his different types of writing patterns. He always talks to his soul for some creative suggestions. Now he wants to write about a character called "Yaantrik". Siddharth wants to write a book on Yaantrik but this time as an experiment he wants to become a Yaantrik and then write a book. He will follow the routine of Yaantrik. His inner soul is not convinced with this idea. After being blocked in his own idea how his inner soul helped him out is the film.

programme.title: Tohfa
programme.desc: A gentleman bestowed upon his cherished wife an incredibly valuable and heartwarming present, yet fate had a different plan in store for their journey.

programme.title: Vansh
programme.desc: Dive into the powerful narrative of Vansh, a heartfelt short film from Vidyarthi Studios & Pocket Films, that explores the societal pressures surrounding gender expectations. This gripping tale follows a father's fierce desire for a son over his beloved daughter, shedding light on deep-seated beliefs and cultural traditions. As he grapples with his emotions, this poignant story opens a discussion about love, acceptance, and true parenthood. Don’t miss this eye-opening film that promises to challenge perceptions and evoke empathy.

programme.title: Love Range
programme.desc: In the bustling metro city of Mumbai, Ayush and Roohi's lives are turned upside down by the COVID-19 pandemic. When Ayush loses his job, Roohi decides to start a tiffin service to support the family, but Raj's traditional views and wounded ego create tension as he struggles with the idea of his wife being the breadwinner.

programme.title: Suta
programme.desc: Suta (The Daughter) is the story of a bold and smart daughter who fights for the sacrifices of her mother which went unnoticed in the family. She emerges victorious and sees that her mother gains back her confidence.

programme.title: Catharsis
programme.desc: A poignant journey of a man forced onto a path of self-discovery, exploring the depths of the human mind and spirit.

programme.title: Threes A Couple
programme.desc: 3 Lives Change after they cross each other's path on one auspicious night.

programme.title: Tithlee
programme.desc: Yamini, newly married, is getting ready to meet her mother-in-law, Reema's, friends and family. Reema suggests that Yamini should appear more presentable at the party and implies a preference for fair skin. Both Yamini and Reema's son, Ankush, want to challenge this prejudice, but they have different approaches.

programme.title: Kahwa
programme.desc: Set in July 2016, in the kashmir valley, post the encounter of militant Burhan Wadi, a period that had resulted in the loss of almost 70 lives and injured over 11000 people. A young CRPF official called Surkhab is sent to kashmir as a part of his very first posting along with a few other officers in the very first week of this curfew. Although he so posted in a small base where the clashes were not seen, yet he senses a feeling of fear and tense throughout. Surkhab who is very proud & committed army officer and at the same time mesmerised by the beauty of the valley and often wonders why a place so beautiful feels like a war zone. He arrives in the area and is assigned to maintain peace during the volatile period. He is determined to do his job with utmost sincerity and discipline. During one of his rounds, Surkhab meets Shaukhat, a tea seller, who is initially reluctant to interact with him due to the ongoing tensions. However, Surkhab insists on having a cup of tea with him, and slowly, they start talking about their lives and experiences. Shaukat has a grandson who loves to play cricket but is snatched the freedom of doing so due to the curfew. He gets together with some of his adult friends and they often secretly play gully cricket. As the curfew continues, Surkhab and Shaukat's bond grows stronger, and they discuss the unrest in the neighborhood, their families, and their dreams for a peaceful future. Despite their initial differences, Surkhab and Shaukhat find a common ground of acceptance and understanding over their shared cups of tea.However, this new found equation is put to the test when an unexpected event takes place, forcing them to confront their beliefs and loyalties. Kahwa is a story of how two individuals from vastly different backgrounds and ideologies can come together and form a bond of acceptance and empathy, even in the face of adversity.

programme.title: Vishaad
programme.desc: When a weary inspector is drawn to a reclusive scientist’s house on the edge of a quiet town, his investigation takes an unexpected turn. What begins as a routine inquiry slowly unfolds into an encounter with memory itself where loss finds an intangible resonance, and silence begins to speak. Vishaad is a lyrical meditation on grief, time, and the fragile human desire to regurgitate all that the heart has tried to bury.

programme.title: Aflatoon
programme.desc: A narrative unfolding the tale of two brothers residing far from their home, eager to dispatch a sweet treat to their unwell father.

programme.title: Ansh
programme.desc: When Nidhi visits an orphanage with hopes of adopting, she is confronted by the unresolved trauma of losing her own child to kidnapping. As she battles grief and depression, she must find a way to heal and embrace life again. A poignant tale of loss, resilience, and the power of hope.

programme.title: Akhiri Parchi
programme.desc: This movie serves as an inspirational tool for kids, helping them grasp the extent of their parents' sacrifices and efforts to ensure their lives are comfortable and fulfilling, despite challenging circumstances. It aims to convey a powerful message, encouraging children to maximize their available resources and strive for their best.

programme.title: Eelu Rani Bhag Gaye
programme.desc: Two teenagers running away from their home comes across a police officer who persuades them not to go, however Eelu & Rani have something else on their mind.

programme.title: Yathaarth
programme.desc: A time travel story of a husband & wife who revisit their past memories through a new technology called Alternate Reality Correction Services, thinking they can resolve their own issues through it.

programme.title: Husbands
programme.desc: When Aadav visits his ex-wife’s house to give his son a gift, he is greeted at the door by Satvik, the man who has replaced him in his ex's life, and maybe even his son’s.

programme.title: Raat Hamaari Hai
programme.desc: Rakesh, a virgin, is set up by his friends with an escort, Madhu(who happens to be a psychology student). They both have opposite thoughts on sex and a debate ensues between them over the course of the night and then finally what happens between them.

programme.title: Chilgam
programme.desc: A story of love and courage that strives to sustain amidst a communally-charged environment.

programme.title: Kathi Pe Ghoda
programme.desc: An old man living a life full of mistakes gets an extraordinary experience only to realize that he is the ultimate creator of his destiny.

programme.desc: On the night before her wedding an Indian - American bride pays visit to her ex whom she ghosted years ago

programme.desc: Dhruv returns from London after completing his studies and goes straight to meet Jai. He ends up waiting for him in his room where he remembers their time together through Jai’s poems and photographs. He looks disturbed as he tries to keep one particular memory at bay all the while wondering what will happen when Jai walks in the door.

programme.desc: Happiness comes knocking at the door on one of her most gloomy days during the pandemic. She embraces it & now it ain't easy to go

programme.desc: A riveting psychological thriller that propels an aspiring actor's life into chaos when a toothache triggers an unfounded belief in oral cancer, setting off a catastrophic chain of events.

programme.title: Painkiller
programme.desc: Ronnie’s world comes crashing down, when his wife leaves him. The feeling of losing his wife and daughter is something he can’t wrap his head around.

programme.desc: This dark topical narrates the story of Jude, who's been suffering from psychosis, a mental health illness & has an aberrational relation with the voice in his head.

programme.desc: A sweet, endearing tale of two old school lovers and their conversations, carried out over shy, fond letters creating an emotional heart touching last letter.

programme.title: The Bench
programme.desc: A young man’s monotonous life turns upside down when he meets a stranger on a bench.

programme.title: Omlette
programme.desc: After being unable to contact her son Rohan and her daughter-in-law for days, Anupama visits Rohan’s place to find out the reason behind this unusual behaviour and an evening full of tension and emotions lead to a shocking end to her search.

programme.title: Naam Kya Hai
programme.desc: Set in the 1992 riots in Mumbai, "Naam Kya Hai?" revolves around a distraught and prejudiced police officer trying to avenge the murder of his wife amidst the communal tension in the city.

programme.desc: True Story that follows America’s most notorious Female Serial killer. Based on Aileen Wuorno’s early life. Tormented by her inner demons she surrenders to her murderous impulses havoc in the peaceful community.

programme.title: Ted Bundy: American Boogeyman
programme.desc: This is the true story behind the manhunt that brought America’s most fearsome boogeyman to justice. His name is Ted Bundy. A specter roams the highways of the gritty 1970s America hunting for his next prey. Tracking him are intrepid FBI female agent Kathleen & Robert Ressler organizers of the largest manhunt in history to apprehend America’s most Notorious infamous serial killer.

programme.title: Spytime

programme.title: Hatching
programme.desc: In the most terrifying creature feature Hatching is a story about lovelessness that creates a monster. After finding a wounded bird in the woods, a 12 year old brings its strange egg home, she hides it and keeps it warm until it hatches. The creature that emerges becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare. What has she been hatching under everyone's noses that shocks them all?

programme.title: Orphan First Kill
programme.desc: After orchestrating a brilliant escape from an Estonian psychiatric facility, Esther travels to America by impersonating the missing daughter of a wealthy family. Yet, an unexpected twist arises that pits her against a mother who will protect her family from the murderous "child" at any cost.

programme.title: Room 203
programme.desc: Many residents of ROOM 203 have disappeared since the murder suicide of a married couple exactly fifty years ago. Lifelong friends Kim and Izzy and roommates are terrified by the vengeful spirits dwelling in their apartment. To save Izzy's life, Kim may need to sacrifice her own. Based on the Internationally Bestselling novel by Kamon Nanami.

programme.title: Nefarious

programme.desc: Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. programme.title: Love, Bites
programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: Agarbatti
programme.desc: Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel’s Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery; both personal and culinary. Ranveer’s passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children’s turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn’t happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani’s lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India’S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi’S & Bahu’S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What’S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law’s. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law’s family.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore’S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore’.Tagore’S Words And Basu’S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga’S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga’S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga’S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: Annoying Things People Do In Your Car
programme.desc: The video is a comedic breakdown of the various ways passengers can drive a car owner (the "driver") absolutely crazy. It captures the struggle of trying to keep your car pristine while your friends treat it like a public lounge.

programme.title: Types Of Shoppers
programme.desc: The video humorously identifies and satirizes the various personas we all adopt the moment we step into a shopping center. It breaks down the stereotypes of shopping and, in classic FilterCopy fashion, flips the script on gendered expectations—showing that men can be just as obsessive or indecisive as women when it comes to fashion.

programme.title: Thoughts You Have While Studying
programme.desc: The video is a comedic dive into the brain of a student who is desperately trying to focus but is constantly derailed by distractions, procrastination, and existential dread. It perfectly captures the "pre-exam" struggle where everything in the world seems more interesting than the textbook in front of you.

programme.title: Backbenchers Vs Toppers
programme.desc: The sketch reimagines the battle between disciplined Toppers and chaotic Backbenchers as a supernatural war. Inspired by Brahmastra, it turns exams and school life into a dramatic, high-stakes fight for ultimate power.

programme.title: Savage Millennial Vs Savage Gen Z
programme.desc: The video explores the generational divide through a series of "savage" exchanges between a Millennial (struggling to keep up) and a Gen Z protagonist (who seems to have a slang for everything). It highlights the hilarious friction that occurs when Millennial "hustle culture" meets Gen Z "boundaries."

programme.title: Life In Boy's School
programme.desc: The video is a high-energy, chaotic exploration of the "survival game" that is an all-boys school. It captures the specific brand of brotherhood, unfiltered humor, and lack of decorum that defines these institutions, moving away from typical co-ed romance to focus purely on the "bro" dynamic.

programme.title: People We See In Every Exam!
programme.desc: The video is a humorous "field guide" to the specific personalities you encounter in a high-pressure examination hall. It captures the frantic, sometimes absurd behavior of students during those three hours of "do or die" academic battle.

programme.title: What If Dhurandhar Was Set In An Office?
programme.desc: The sketch reimagines the intense, high-stakes world of international espionage as the equally "dangerous" jungle of a modern 9-to-5 office. It follows an undercover agent who is sent into a rival firm—not to stop a terror cell, but to prevent the poaching of a major client.

programme.title: Life In A Girls' School
programme.desc: The video explores the "behind-the-scenes" reality of growing up in an all-girls environment—shattering the dainty stereotypes often seen in movies and replacing them with the raw, chaotic, and fiercely loyal brotherhood (or sisterhood) that actually exists.

programme.title: Gen Z Gf Millennial Bf
programme.desc: The story follows a couple navigating the humorous friction that arises when a Millennial's "old school" habits clash with a Gen Z's digital-first lifestyle. It moves beyond simple "slang" jokes to show how their different outlooks on work, romance, and even weekend plans create both conflict and a unique kind of balance.

programme.title: Life In Iit
programme.desc: The video moves past the "glamour" of the IIT brand to show the gritty, exhausting, and heartwarming reality of hostel life. It follows three roommates as they navigate the transition from being "JEE toppers" in their hometowns to being "average students" in a campus full of geniuses.

programme.title: Parents On Facebook
programme.desc: The video is a satirical look at the digital generation gap. It follows a son (Dhruv) as he deals with the social media "awakening" of his mother (Kritika), who approaches Facebook with the same intensity and lack of boundaries she uses in real-life parenting.

programme.title: Confusing Things Girlfriends Say
programme.desc: The video is a comedic "survival guide" for boyfriends trying to navigate the often contradictory and cryptic language of their significant others. It humorously deconstructs the hidden meanings behind common phrases that leave men scratching their heads.

programme.title: Annoying Things Boyfriends Do
programme.desc: While the first video looked at the "mysterious" language of girlfriends, this sketch flips the perspective. It humorously catalogs the predictable, clumsy, and often thoughtless habits of boyfriends that test their partners' patience.

programme.title: What Not To Say In A Relationship
programme.desc: The video follows a series of scenarios where a partner says the absolute worst possible thing at a sensitive moment. It highlights how even a small, unintentionally honest comment can be interpreted as a declaration of war.

programme.title: Things Brothers & Sisters Do
programme.desc: The video is a rapid-fire montage of the daily friction and unspoken affection that defines a sibling bond. It moves past the "emotional" stereotypes to show the hilarious, grounded reality of living under the same roof.

programme.title: Last Diwali Before Moving Out
programme.desc: When you are leaving your house, every moment becomes unforgettable especially festivities like Diwali which makes core memories of growing up Desi.

programme.title: If Google Were A Delhi Boy
programme.desc: The video imagines how Google might behave if it were a stereotypical “Delhi boy” — flashy, informal, always full of attitude. It plays with contrasts like professionalism vs. casual swagger, creating funny scenarios when tech meets typical Delhi-style personality.

programme.title: When You Grow Up With Strict Desi Parents
programme.desc: The video humorously shows the challenges of growing up with strict Desi parents, from high expectations to limited freedom.

programme.title: When You Are The Only Girl In The Group
programme.desc: You’re the lone girl surrounded by guys – every conversation, joke or decision seems to orbit around you. The video captures the awkward, funny, and endearing moments you tweak just to “fit in.”

programme.title: Annoying Things Husbands Do
programme.desc: From forgetting dates to TV remote fights—an affectionate roast of husbands everywhere.

programme.title: If Google Were Poo
programme.desc: A quirky comedic sketch where imagining the search-engine giant as something ridiculous (like “Poo”) highlights how absurd our online habits and dependence on instant answers have become.

programme.title: When Love Begins With Hate
programme.desc: The classic “I can’t stand you” turns into “I actually kinda like you”: fights, sarcasm, pranks—and that moment when your irritation flips into something you can’t ignore.

programme.title: Hotel California
programme.desc: Maya, a Gen Z UX designer, joins Thoda Sukoon — a mental health startup with strict office hours, long workdays, and zero breathing space. Expecting flexibility and support, she instead finds herself caught in a whirlwind of deadlines and old-school hustle. As pressure mounts ahead of a major product launch and funding round, Maya connects with her burnt-out teammates. But when it comes to challenging the system — who’s willing to speak up?

programme.title: The Launch
programme.desc: Tight deadlines. Zero chill. And one very fed-up Maya. Maya’s ideas get ghosted, her dedication’s under the scanner, and the team? Busy minding their own burnout. Just when she finds a bit of empathy, things spiral again. Sleep is a myth, pressure is real, and Maya’s had enough. But when push comes to shove… does she stay, or finally hit CTRL+ALT+ESC?

programme.title: All Is Well
programme.desc: Maya’s impulsive decision leaves her awkward around Chirag, who doesn’t miss a chance to tease her. As they open up about their generational views on work and life, Maya reaffirms her belief in mental health and Thoda Sukoon’s mission. But just as things start looking up, a bold move in a high-stakes meeting sparks serious tension with the higher-ups. Can Maya recover when her values put her at odds with the very system she’s trying to change?

programme.title: The Breakdown
programme.desc: While the team scrambles to fix minor app bugs, the real issues at Thoda Sukoon are swept under the rug — until it all explodes. An employee collapses from overwork, triggering a full-blown social media backlash. As tensions rise, Maya and Chirag are forced to face unresolved conflict, and the team must ask: how far is too far? Can this crisis spark real change in a toxic work culture, or is it already too late?

programme.title: The Cliffhanger
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Riddhi's collapse, Zooni spearheads a desperate negotiation for better working conditions. As a seemingly balanced work environment emerges, the team struggles to deliver, and blurred lines between professional and personal lives begin to fray. Are these simply growing pains for Thoda Sukoon, or are fresh, explosive complications on the horizon?

programme.title: The Misfit
programme.desc: India’s fashion matriarch, Zahira, is making a bold move - bringing Zahiraan into the world of wearable luxury. But there’s a catch - neither she nor her team knows how to navigate this shift. Thus, comes in Ayesha - a rookie designer, a dreamer bursting with fresh ideas. But will she survive the cut-throat competition in fashion and at Zahiraan? Get ready for an intense drama, glamorous showdowns, and career-defining moments as the battle for success begins at Zahiraan.

programme.title: Time To Shine
programme.desc: Ayesha’s out-of-the-box ideas leave a mark on Zahira, but not everyone is impressed. As she tries to navigate the high-pressure world of fashion, her bold creativity ignites a war with her team. Amidst the chaos, an unexpected friendship with Sanchi gives Ayesha the confidence boost she desperately needs. But in an industry where talent isn’t enough, will this newfound support be her key to a major breakthrough?

programme.title: The Big Launch
programme.desc: The much-awaited Zahiraan launch is here, but disaster strikes! One unexpected error threatens to crumble Ayesha's hard-won validation from Zahira, and jeopardize both their careers. Meanwhile, Karan battles crippling self-doubt, wondering if he'll ever measure up to the perfection demanded by the high-stakes fashion world. Will their reputations survive?

programme.title: Perfect Shaadi
programme.desc: Aditya and Prajakta are all set to tie the knot! As they navigate the excitement and chaos of wedding planning, a surprise guest from Prajakta's past arrives, turning their perfect day upside down. Will love triumph over unexpected challenges?

programme.title: Basundi Ki Bhasudi
programme.desc: As Aditya and Prajakta celebrate their pre-wedding festivities, a shocking twist turns their world upside down! Will they handle the chaos together?

programme.title: Hum Tum Aur?
programme.desc: A perfect wedding, a hidden secret, and a love under threat. Will Aditya and Prajakta's love story survive the test of time?

programme.title: Bride Ka Best Man
programme.desc: As pre-wedding festivities unfold, Aditya stumbles upon a secret only Prajakta’s best friend knew. Can he handle the parts of her he’s just beginning to see?

programme.title: Imperfect Shaadi
programme.desc: The episode centers on the wedding of the lead couple, where everything seemingly goes wrong. However, instead of letting the chaos ruin the day, the couple realizes that the "imperfections" of their wedding reflect the reality of their relationship. They choose to embrace the mess, focusing on their commitment to each other.

programme.desc: The series introduces Nishant, Sakshi, and Huma as they begin their MBBS journey, adjusting to the demanding environment of medical college and forming new friendships.

programme.title: Diagnosis
programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.title: Complications
programme.desc: Midterm results bring surprises, prompting celebrations that uncover deeper issues the friends must confront together.

programme.title: Surgery
programme.desc: Huma faces a crisis of confidence, seeking unconventional advice to regain her footing. A heartbreaking event forces the friends to reevaluate their priorities and the strength of their bond.

programme.title: Recovery
programme.desc: As final exams approach, Huma contemplates unethical shortcuts, leading to revelations that challenge perceptions and test the integrity of their friendship.

programme.desc: The series introduces Nishant, Sakshi, and Huma as they begin their MBBS journey, adjusting to the demanding environment of medical college and forming new friendships.

programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.desc: Midterm results bring surprises, prompting celebrations that uncover deeper issues the friends must confront together.

programme.title: Critical Condition

programme.title: Fomo
programme.desc: Dhruv and Kavya plan a lazy Sunday but feel the pressure of missing out when they see their friends enjoying exciting activities on social media. This leads them to seek ways to spice up their day.

programme.title: Have A Nice Day
programme.desc: A morning rush to work results in a tussle between Dhruv and Kavya, spoiling their moods. Throughout the day, they attempt to make amends, highlighting the irony and sweetness of their relationship.

programme.title: Good Night
programme.desc: A sleepless night due to mosquitoes leads to the discovery that Kavya's ex-boyfriend is getting married, prompting a long conversation about their past relationships.

programme.title: Thank You!
programme.desc: Plans for a dinner at an Iranian restaurant get canceled, leading Dhruv and Kavya to attend a friend's house party. The night evolves into an unexpected adventure, ending at a local fair.

programme.title: Here We Go!
programme.desc: During a visit to a vineyard, Dhruv and Kavya open up about their insecurities and future aspirations, leading to deeper conversations about life and their relationship.

programme.title: Masterji
programme.desc: Kishore, an orphan has only one dream, to join the IndianArmy. When he gets thrown out of his orphanage, Masterji, an ex-army officer who left the army and is now working as a tailor, reluctantly adopts him. The khadoos Masterji and Kishore have only two things in common, their dream to serve the nation and their lonely lives. Will Masterji help Kishore achieve his own unfulfilled dreams to become a soldier, and will Kishore find a father in Masterji?

programme.title: Jaldi Lautna, Captain
programme.desc: Captain Vikrant Sahay and his wife Vibha had a beautiful love story. But Vikrant’s sudden death in battle leaves the otherwise happy-go-lucky Vibha completely shocked. Unable to deal with Vikrant’s death, Vibha decides that the best way to honor him is to fulfill his dream, by joining the army herself, much against her family’s wishes. Will Vibha succeed and make her late husband, her family, and the country proud?

programme.title: Shooter Jawan
programme.desc: Tribhuvan, a dedicated Indian Army Officer comes across a young sweeper Tinku, who is a gifted shooter. Tribhuvan knows Tinku has a rare talent, and wants to enroll him in the shooting academy and then the Indian Army. However, owing to Tinku’s caste, his father is afraid of society’s taunts and is completely against this career choice. Will Tinku have the courage to fight back and rise above ‘log kya kahenge’?

programme.title: Sarhad Ke Baad Bhi
programme.desc: Colonel Balram, a retired Indian Army Officer, returns home after several years of service, only to find himself completely disconnected from his son Aman. While Balram is failing at mending his relationship with Aman, he is also silently struggling with mental health issues, because of his days at war. Will Aman ever understand his father’s sacrifices for the country or will it be too late before he realises just how much his father loves him?

programme.title: Veera
programme.desc: Veera’s martyred father’s last wish was for her to join the Indian armed forces. But Veera is not for it. The bravery and patriotism that the country remembers and celebrates him for, are the same things that took Veera’s father away from her. She’s been carrying this anger and hurt in her heart for too long, until she discovers a hidden letter.

programme.title: Bachelorhood
programme.desc: Viraj and Arjun have been best friends since childhood. While Viraj loves his bachelor life and wants Arjun to move in as his flatmate, Arjun has other plans of ‘settling down’. What happens when this bachelor reveals he wants to be ‘unbachelored?’

programme.title: Kabab Mein Haddi
programme.desc: The gang gets together to celebrate Arjun’s big news, but Viraj is concerned whether the dynamics of the group will change with its new addition. Will Khushi win over the gang and get Viraj's stamp of approval?

programme.title: (un)happy Birthday
programme.desc: Its Arjun’s birthday, and Khushi steals the limelight with her unconventional celebration party. Tensions at the party rise when Viraj confronts Arjun about his change in behaviour since he started dating Khushi. Will Arjun pick pyaar or dosti?

programme.title: Mann Ki Rant
programme.desc: The group tries to resolve tensions between Viraj and Arjun, but they both resist. As Viraj rants to Zara and Kaka about his friendships and relationships, he realises more about his true self.

programme.title: Yaar Ki Shaadi
programme.desc: The wedding day is here! Will Viraj stand by Arjun on the most important day of his life, and will he admit his true feelings to a special someone?

programme.title: Conflict Of Interest
programme.desc: Shagun wants to keep the Filmy Weddings business floating and for that she’s willing to go to any lengths. Even if it means shooting a wedding film for Adhira’s ex-boyfriend – Akhil. Adhira is furious and tries her best to sabotage the entire project. Unfortunately, her one big hurdle is Dad, who has taken quite a fondness for Akhil. Check out the episode and find out what happens next!

programme.title: rakhwale
programme.desc: NSG commando Tushar Joshi recounts his role in the 2002 Akshardham terror attack and the 14-hour Operation Vajra Shakti, offering a first-hand account of tactics, sacrifice, and rescue efforts. The episode examines the operation's planning and execution and honors the bravery of the forces involved.

programme.title: neta nagari
programme.desc: A political journalism segment examining Narendra Modi’s rise from Gujarat Chief Minister to national leadership, exploring his strengths, challenges, and the major questions that have shaped his public career.

programme.title: mater class
programme.desc: Dr. Khinviraj Jangid, Director of the Centre for Israel Studies at O.P. Jindal Global University, explains Israel's 2026 elections from A to Z—how Knesset elections work, Netanyahu and Likud's journey, the Bennett-Lapid alliance, and coalition formation. The conversation also covers the Gaza war, Iran, Hezbollah, Trump, and India-Israel ties.

programme.title: cinema adda
programme.desc: Namrata G. Singh joins The Lallantop’s Cinema Adda for a conversation about cinema, storytelling and the film industry. Watch the full discussion for insights, experiences and perspectives on the world of films.

programme.title: kitabwala
programme.desc: In this special episode of Kitaabwala, author Kushal Mehra joins Kuldeep Mishra for a sharp conversation about his book "Blasphemy." They explore religion, atheism, conversion, truth claims, and whether sacred ideas should be questioned.

programme.title: guest in the newsroom
programme.desc: In this episode of Guest In The Newsroom, singer Lakhbir Singh Lakha speaks with Kuldeep Mishra about his musical journey and the stories behind iconic bhajans like "Pyara Saja Hai Tera Dwar Bhawani," "Maiya Ka Chola Hai Rang Lal," and "Are Dwarpalo." The conversation also touches on Khalistan, Sidhu Moose Wala, Daler Mehndi, Gulshan Kumar, and his views on the changing music industry.

programme.title: lt insider
programme.desc: Spain's protests over housing and rising rents have brought the tenant vs landlord debate into focus, raising the question of how much of it is relevant to India. From rental agreements to rules imposed by landlords, we take a closer look at the issues that shape the rental housing experience.

programme.title: kitabwala
programme.desc: In this Kitabwala episode, former High Commissioner Prashant Agrawal speaks to Dhananjay Kumar about Project Cheetah—the diplomacy, negotiations, and challenges behind bringing African cheetahs to India after 70 years.

programme.desc: It's Mickey Mouse's birthday, and he's sure his friends are throwing him a party. There's just one problem . . . there are no signs of a party. Have Mickey's friends forgotten all about his big day?

programme.title: Mickey'S Spooky Night
programme.desc: Read about your favorite Disney characters and their spooky adventures!

programme.title: Minnie Saves Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.desc: With this collection of spooky Halloween stories, little ones will be tricked and treated off to sleep with some of their favorite Disney and Pixar characters.

programme.title: Minnie's Surprise
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy are hired to babysit Clara Cluck's egg, but it begins to hatch on their watch! Follow as the Happy Helpers try to get the mama hen and her egg back together in time.

programme.desc: Mickey and the gang head to Italy to compete in the Race for the Rigatoni Ribbon. Do the Roadster Racers have a chance at winning the race? Follow along with word-for-word narration to find out!

programme.title: A Hot-Dog Day

programme.title: Minnie-rella

programme.title: Colors All Around

programme.title: Mickey Saves Santa
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends are all ready for a Christmas Eve sleepover at the Clubhouse. They've written their lists and can't wait for Santa Claus to arrive. Santa won't be coming unless he gets some help!

programme.title: Mickey's Easter Hunt
programme.desc: The Clubhouse pals are throwing an Easter party and Pete's upset because he thinks he isn't invited. Pete decides to make a change in the Clubhouse, he makes it disappear-with the friends still inside!

programme.title: Mickey's Halloween Treat
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends want to go to the Tower, for the Halloween party but, they have to get there before the moon is full! Toodles and Mouseketools are what Mickey need to find on his way to the tower.

programme.title: Minnie's Rainbow
programme.desc: In this colorful tale, Minnie Mouse simply explains how these beautiful apparitions are formed. Follow the narration as Minnie and her Clubhouse pals begin to see a world of rainbows around them.

programme.title: Top O' The Clubhouse
programme.desc: It's Saint Patrick's Day. Mickey and the gang are ready to celebrate! But when Pete's shenanigans threaten to ruin their celebration, it will take some help from Toodles, to get the party back on track.

programme.title: Homesick
programme.desc: Being sick is no fun for anyone, but Funny's sneezes are extra funny! Every sneeze sends Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gang through the wrong Adventure Doors. Will Funny ever feel better?

programme.title: Donald'S Stinky Day
programme.desc: When Donald accidentally rescues a cute little skunk, the grateful little stinker refuses to leave his side!

programme.title: Mickey'S Perfecto Day
programme.desc: Mickey and the Roadster Racers head to Madrid, Spain for some racing and sightseeing fun. But when a baby bull begins to chase them around town, their perfecto vacation starts to crumble!

programme.title: Ski Trippin
programme.desc: The gang is teaching Daisy to ski when she accidentally ends up in the middle of aa big skiing race! Using the skills she's learned along the way, can she pull off a big win?

programme.title: Hocus Bow-Cus
programme.desc: Minnie is launching her new 'Bows are Magical' fashion line. He forgot his bow tie at home, he rushes off to find it. Millie and Melody rehearsed with Penguini, but will they remember all the tricks?

programme.title: Minnie's Pet Salon
programme.desc: Minnie and friends get ready to pamper their pets at Minnie's Pet Salon! It's a spa day like no other for Pluto, Figaro, Bella, Butch, and Mr. Pettibone!

programme.title: The Case Of The Missing Sparkle-izer
programme.desc: Who's been using Minnie's new Sparkle-izer? When Minnie needs it to decorate her customers' bows, the Super Sparkle-izer turns up missing! It's up to Millie and Melody to solve the mystifying mystery!

programme.title: Always In Fashion
programme.desc: Minnie Mouse is always in fashion! She and Daisy love making bows at Minnie's Bow-tique. All of their friends want Minnie to make them bows.

programme.title: Blooming Bows
programme.desc: Minnie's nieces are very upset! The paper petals on their costumes are falling apart. Now, it''s up to Minnie to redesign the girls' costumes. But can she do it in time for the school's Posy Pageant?

programme.title: Bow-Bot Robot
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy get some help from a bow-making robot in this retelling of an episode of Disney Junior's Minnie's Bow Toons.

programme.title: Easter Bonnet Parade
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! One day, a little puppy with nowhere to go arrived at the Main Street USA train station. Seeking for a place to call his own, follow along as the little pup explores the town.

programme.title: Trouble Times Two
programme.desc: Movie star Penelope Poodle has come to Minnie''s Bow-Tique to find something perfect to wear. But when Minnie''s mischievous twin nieces, Millie and Melody, come for a visit, it''s Trouble Times Two!

programme.title: Year Round Fun
programme.desc: Book with magnet set in a case

programme.title: Riches To Rags
programme.desc: A young boy is taken to work by his Papa and Grandpa in an old wooden boat. He discovers his family's unusual line of work and will decide whether to follow them or find his way.

programme.title: Blue-Ribbon Bunny
programme.desc: Sofia and her bunny Clover enter a pet contest. Other kids have fancy pets. Sofia must decide: enter with a fancy pet or stay loyal to her best friend, Clover.

programme.title: Clover Time
programme.desc: When Clover's warren floods, Sofia invites her to move in. They love sharing a room-at first. But Sofia soon learns that being roommates isn't always easy in this fun story!

programme.title: Just One Of The Princes
programme.desc: Sofia wants to try out for a spot on Royal Prep's Flying Derby team, but Amber, Prince Hugo, and her classmates tell Sofia that Flying Derby is not a 'princess thing.'

programme.title: The Missing Necklace
programme.desc: When the Amulet of Avalor goes missing, Sofia loses her ability to understand her friends. Longing to talk to her friends again, Sofia sets off to find it. Cedric is also after the missing amulet.

programme.title: Welcome To Royal Prep
programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: Big Bear, Little Bear
programme.desc: Enter the world of Brave and learn about opposites.

programme.title: Oh, Brother

programme.title: Merida And The Missing Gem
programme.desc: Join the Disney reading. Merida chooses a beautiful brooch for her mother's birthday, but the pin goes missing, and she, with friends, has to search the castle grounds to find it.

programme.title: One Perfect Day
programme.desc: Despite being instructed to behave like a typical princess, Disney's Princess Merida desires to practice archery, explore the kingdom, and be herself for a day.

programme.title: Cinderella's Best Ever Creations
programme.desc: The story explores how Cinderella must work to create a collection of dresses in a time-crunch. She creates beautiful gowns for girls and solves problems by creating an extra dress in a time crunch.

programme.title: The Great Cat-tastrophe
programme.desc: Cinderella agrees to help Lady Dupont watch the cats, Cinderella finds a clever way for them to lend a hand on her chores. Follow along as Cinderella and the cats tidy up the house together.

programme.desc: Ella's stepfamily is jeaous of her beauty and grace and tries to stop her from going to the royal ball. Will Ella make it to the ball and get her happily ever after?

programme.title: Beware Of The Kakamora

programme.title: Budderball'S First Fair

programme.title: Heavy Metal Mater
programme.desc: Mater and the Gas Caps, records a hit song, Mater becomes a rock legend. Then Lightning joins Mater's band for the rock concert of the century!

programme.title: Hauntley Girls
programme.desc: Vampirina and her mom start a book club. The first book is magical and spells the humans. They work hard to break the spell. Will they succeed?

programme.title: A Day To Remember
programme.desc: Elena loves celebrating Dia de los Muertos-The Day of the Dead-in Avalor. It's a day of remembrance to honor and celebrate her ancestors.

programme.title: Take Your Pet To The Vet
programme.desc: Doc's hamster, Coleslaw, needs a checkup. But there's one problem . . . Coleslaw isn't a toy, so it's time to take this pet to the vet! .

programme.title: Meet Blondie And Berry
programme.desc: Meet Blondie, a pony with royal aspirations, and Berry, a food-loving bunny, as they form unexpected friendships with Rapunzel and Snow White in enchanting adventures.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Cinderella's classic talebrings the timeless story of Cinderella to life! She meets the prince of her dreams, her Fairy Godmother, and dances at the royal ball.

programme.title: Cloud Country

programme.title: Babysitter Bunga

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
